purpose: Teach: 地方裁判所/光学/良識/米価/併合/異質/筆記/伝授

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地方裁判所の判例研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on precedent cases from district courts, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. She knows the answer — this is an invitation to share. Measured pace, gentle interest. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、光学顕微鏡の解像度研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on optical microscope resolution research.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest. A slight pause before answering, as if checking his own words. Clear but not defensive. A small, genuine tone — just the facts.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、市民の良識形成の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on how citizens develop sound judgment, correct?
lines.style: Gentle reframing, slightly curious. Not correcting — inviting him to expand or clarify. Thoughtful pace, like she's turning something over.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、米価の長期変動研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the long-term fluctuations in rice prices.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. A beat of clarity before each phrase. Not performing uncertainty — just stating what he researched. Grounded tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近世の国家併合史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper examined the history of state consolidation in the early modern period, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged, genuinely interested now. Slight lift in tone. She's following the thread of his research. Open, conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、異質な文化の共生研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on how dissimilar cultures can coexist together.
lines.style: Quiet conviction beneath the surface. He's talking about something that matters. Slow, deliberate. Voice steady but not cold — present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、筆記試験形式の妥当性を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you explored the validity of written examination formats in your paper, isn't that right?
lines.style: Reflective, drawing out understanding. Like she's piecing together a larger picture. Warm but measured. Patient pause before the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、伝統工芸の伝授制度研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the transmission systems of traditional craftsmanship.
lines.style: Final statement, grounded and complete. Quiet determination at the close. No trailing — just finished. The exhale of someone reaching clarity.
